The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance
Filling of a vacancy in the office of member of the elpitiya pradeshiya sabha under section 66A(1)(a) of the local authorities elections ordinance (chapter 262)
WHEREAS the office of member of Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Death ;

And whereas the Secretary of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna, the recognized political party to which Widisingha Garudasa the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66A(1)(a) of the aforesaid Ordinance, to decide upon the member of that No. 12 Wallambagala of Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs to such party who shall be declared elected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days;
And whereas the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized Political party has communicated his decision to nominate Malwaththage Dilan Kapila to fill such vacancy;

Therefore I, Wewelwala Hewage Ravindra Wijaya Kumara, Returning Officer of the Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha, acting in terms of Section 66A(1)(a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that Malwaththage Dilan Kapila was elected as member of the No. 12 Wallambagala of Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha. W. H. R. Wijaya Kumara, Returning Officer, Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha. District Election Office,Galle,08th February, 2024.
